Animal Bite Treatment Center: City Health Office Compound

PhilHealth Member Data Record (if available, though care is free for all indigents)

service: Roxas City Animal Bite Treatment Center
description: Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) anti-rabies vaccination, wound cleaning, and tetanus toxoid administration for animal bite victims.
steps: Wash animal bite or scratch thoroughly with running water and soap for at least 15 minutes.
Proceed immediately to the Roxas City Animal Bite Treatment Center at City Hall Compound.
Triage evaluation and bite category assessment by attending nurse/physician.
Administration of anti-rabies vaccine and scheduling of subsequent booster doses.
requirements: Animal observation data (status of the biting dog/cat)

sources.name: National Rabies Prevention and Control Program (DOH)
